d: New York City Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani celebrates Democrats’ major victories in the 2026 US elections with a pointed message for Vice President JD Vance. Declaring that “Americans can't afford two more years,” Mamdani takes aim at Republican leadership and highlights the challenges facing working Americans. As Democrats ride their electoral momentum, Mamdani urges the party to turn its victories into meaningful change.
